paragraphs.source_en: Mitsunari bowed solemnly and departed, still firmly convinced that the Kita no Mandokoro could do nothing; a cold smile never left his face. That gloating Ishida Mitsunari! Nene trembled all over with rage, and could not help becoming angry with herself as well. Did this not prove that her heart was troubled and consumed by jealousy?

units.source_en: Mitsunari bowed solemnly and departed, still firmly convinced that the Kita no Mandokoro could do nothing; a cold smile never left his face.

units.source_zh: 三成郑重地施了一礼，去了，他依然坚信北政所无计可施，脸上始终挂着冷笑。
这个幸灾乐祸的石田三成！

units.source_en: Nene trembled all over with rage, and could not help becoming angry with herself as well.
units.source_zh: 宁宁气得浑身发抖，她不禁生起自己的气来。

units.source_en: Did this not prove that her heart was troubled and consumed by jealousy?
units.source_zh: 这不正说明，她心中郁闷，妒火中烧？

paragraphs.source_zh: 三成郑重地施了一礼，去了，他依然坚信北政所无计可施，脸上始终挂着冷笑。这个幸灾乐祸的石田三成！宁宁气得浑身发抖，她不禁生起自己的气来。这不正说明，她心中郁闷，妒火中烧？

paragraphs.source_en: Why had she allowed herself to become so utterly distraught? Was she angry with Mitsunari, or jealous of Chacha? Or was she afraid of Lady Chacha? Agitation continued to torment Nene, and within it there seemed to lurk a faint, ominous air of bloodshed.

units.source_en: Why had she allowed herself to become so utterly distraught?

ja.t: してしまったのだろう。

units.source_en: Was she angry with Mitsunari, or jealous of Chacha?

ja.t: てているのか、それとも

units.source_en: Or was she afraid of Lady Chacha?
Agitation continued to torment Nene, and within it there seemed to lurk a faint, ominous air of bloodshed.
units.source_zh: 焦躁始终困扰着宁宁，焦躁之中，似隐藏着丝丝不吉的杀气。

paragraphs.source_zh: 为何我竟会方寸大乱？是气三成，还是妒茶茶？或者，是害怕茶茶姬？焦躁始终困扰着宁宁，焦躁之中，似隐藏着丝丝不吉的杀气。

paragraphs.source_en: Now that same premonition would not leave her, and she felt that Hideyoshi himself had planted it within her.

units.source_en: Now that same premonition would not leave her, and she felt that Hideyoshi himself had planted it within her.
units.source_zh: 此刻，相同的预感总挥之不去，她觉得乃是秀吉让她产生了这种感觉。

paragraphs.source_zh: 此刻，相同的预感总挥之不去，她觉得乃是秀吉让她产生了这种感觉。

paragraphs.source_en: Nene also felt that Lady Chacha was deeply unfortunate. She had once tried to like her and draw close to her, but Chacha always kept her at a respectful distance.

units.source_zh: 宁宁也觉得茶茶姬很是不幸，曾想喜欢她、亲近她，茶茶却总是敬而远之。

paragraphs.source_zh: 宁宁也觉得茶茶姬很是不幸，曾想喜欢她、亲近她，茶茶却总是敬而远之。
